Ground execution for physical commodity contracts

We turn procurement mandates into delivered cargo.

DC Consulting sources, processes, documents and ships rare earth minerals, crude oil and gemstones. We work with procurement firms and directly with corporations and institutions.

Make an enquiry See how we work

One contractor, four stages

  1. SourceSecure material at origin and confirm it exists.
  2. ProcessRefine, sort or blend to the buyer’s specification.
  3. DocumentAssemble permits, assays and chain-of-custody records.
  4. ShipMove it to the agreed port, airport or vault.
Why contractors like us exist

The gap between a contract and a cargo

Large buyers often hand sourcing to procurement firms. Those firms then need someone on the ground who can find material, prepare it, clear it and deliver it. That is our role.

One point of accountability

Instead of coordinating miners, laboratories, brokers and carriers separately, you work with one contractor under one agreement.

Verification you control

Your appointed independent inspector can sample and test before release. We do not ask you to trust our word alone.

Your client stays yours

When you subcontract to us, we agree in writing not to approach your end buyer. Confidentiality terms are available before you share details.

How an engagement runs

A clear, documented path

Every mandate follows the same four stages. You can engage us for the full chain or for a single stage.

Read the full service detail
  1. Sourcing and verification of supplyOrigin allocation, ownership checks and baseline sampling.
  2. Processing to specificationBeneficiation, refining, blending, sorting or cutting.
  3. Documentation and compliancePermits, assay reports, provenance records, banking documents.
  4. Logistics and deliveryChartering, containers or secured air transport, with insurance.

Have a requirement or an active mandate?

Tell us what you need, the quantity and where it must be delivered. We will reply with what we can and cannot do.
